detail_text: Specifically, on December 6, 2016 the following was observed during sterile drug production: A) The walls inside the Buffer Room, Gowning Room, and Anteroom are composed of a drywall material that has been painted with an epoxy-based paint. A chip exposing the drywall material was observed on the wall between the door and the metal table in the ISO 7 Buffer Room, where sterile drug processing occurs. B) The frame surrounding the metal HEPA filter screen installed in the ceiling of the Buffer Room, Gowning Room, and Anteroom is composed of an apparent wood material that has been painted with an epoxy-based paint. C) The pass-through box installed between the Buffer Room and Anteroom is composed of a white, laminate wood material that is peeling away from the box frame. D) An overhang light with apparent dust buildup was observed installed above a metal table in the Prep Room where in-process drug components are mixed and heated. The Prep Room contains an ISO 5 biological safety cabinet (BSC) in which sterile drug processing occurs. E) Wheeled stools observed in use in the Buffer Room and Anteroom has a seat composed of an apparent vinyl material, which appears difficult to clean. Gerard P. DeLeon, lnvestigator 12/16/2016 PAGE

detail_text: Specifically: a). Smoke studies were not performed under dynamic conditions to verify that operators, processing equipment or activities of the ISO 7 clean rooms do not alter or impede the unidirectionality of air from the HEPA filters in the two ISO 5 laminar flow hoods, nor the one operational ISO 5 biological safety cabinet where drug products are aseptically processed. b). The two ISO 7 clean rooms, the ISO 7 anteroom, and the unclassified surrounding areas are not continuously monitored for air pressure differentials during production. c). During the semi-annual clean room certification performed by an outside vendor on 1106/14, the differential pressure in the non-hazardous (IV mix room) was found to not meet the required firm's limit. The measurement was at negative 0.007 below the limits of 0.02-0.05, yet no investigation was performed to determine the cause of the recorded value. d). An operator was observed opening a package of sterile gloves by placing the outer non-sterile outer wrapping onto an ISO 5 working surface where sterile drugs were being processed. Additionally, during sterile drug processing the operator was observed placing a non-sterile cloth wipe onto the same ISO 5 working surface. SEE REVERS E
detail_text_ko: 구체적으로: a). 의약품을 무균 처리하는 ISO 5 층류 후드 2대와 가동 중인 ISO 5 생물안전작업대 1대에서, 작업자·공정 설비 또는 ISO 7 청정실의 활동이 HEPA 필터에서 나오는 공기의 단방향성을 바꾸거나 방해하지 않음을 확인하기 위한 연기 시험(smoke study)을 동적 조건에서 수행하지 않았다. b). ISO 7 청정실 2곳, ISO 7 전실, 그리고 분류되지 않은 주변 구역은 생산 중 공기압 차이를 연속적으로 모니터링하지 않는다. c). 외부 업체가 1106/14 에 실시한 반기별 청정실 인증 중, 비위험(IV 혼합실) 구역의 차압이 귀사가 정한 한도를 충족하지 못한 것으로 확인되었다. 측정값은 음압 0.007 로 한도 0.02-0.05 에 미달했으나 기록된 값의 원인을 규명하기 위한 조사는 수행되지 않았다. d). 작업자가 무균 장갑 포장을 개봉하면서 비멸균 겉포장을 무균 의약품이 처리되고 있는 ISO 5 작업면 위에 놓는 모습이 관찰되었다. 또한 무균 의약품 처리 중 작업자가 비멸균 천 와이프를 같은 ISO 5 작업면 위에 놓는 모습이 관찰되었다. detail_text: Specifically, a. CAPA 15038, REDACTED [redacted], was issued for failed media fill Lot REDACTED [redacted], reported during the qualification of one employee REDACTED [redacted], but failed to include a complete evaluation of machine parameters to ensure the reported failure was not associated to operating parameters and failed to include a comprehensive evaluation of impacted product REDACTED [redacted] with the same equipment. The investigation report describes that 5 unit vials (single dose droppers) were found leaking during the post-filling manual inspection, but no additional evaluation of the REDACTED [redacted] parameters was performed and the root cause was determined to be inadequate equipment use and maintenance. b. CAPA 15004, l/15/15, was issued to describe the investigation of leaking units observed during the inspection of dispensed Vigamox 0.5% Lot VI G 121 714NUHM, Tetracaine Hydrochloride. The investigation describes the root cause as a REDACTED [redacted], but no additional information is included to determine the impact to other lots processed in the same machine or evaluate the qualification of the equipment for use. Noreen Muniz, Drog Investigator CAPT Ileana Barreto-Pettit, Drog £nvestigator 06/13/2016
detail_text_ko: 구체적으로, a. CAPA 15038, REDACTED [redacted] 는 직원 1명 REDACTED [redacted] 의 적격성 평가 중 보고된 배지충전 Lot REDACTED [redacted] 부적합에 대해 발행되었으나, 보고된 부적합이 운전 조건과 관련 없음을 보장하기 위한 기계 변수의 완전한 평가를 포함하지 못했고, 같은 설비로 처리한 영향 제품 REDACTED [redacted] 에 대한 포괄적 평가도 포함하지 못했다. 조사 보고서는 충전 후 수동 검사에서 5개 단위 바이알(단회 투여 점적기)이 누출되는 것이 발견되었다고 기술하지만, REDACTED [redacted] 변수에 대한 추가 평가는 수행되지 않았고 근본 원인은 부적절한 설비 사용 및 유지관리로 결정되었다. b. CAPA 15004, l/15/15 는 분주된 Vigamox 0.5% Lot VI G 121 714NUHM, Tetracaine Hydrochloride 의 검사 중 관찰된 누출 단위에 대한 조사를 기술하기 위해 발행되었다. 조사는 근본 원인을 REDACTED [redacted] 로 기술하지만, 같은 기계에서 처리된 다른 로트에 미치는 영향을 판단하거나 사용 설비의 적격성 평가를 평가할 수 있는 추가 정보는 포함되어 있지 않다. detail_text: Specifically, 1. Your firm has not conducted cleaning efficacy studies to assure the suitability and effectiveness of non-sterile Accel TB (0.5% hydrogen peroxide), bleach solution mixed 1:10 dilution with potable water, and sterile 70% isopropyl alcohol used to clean and disinfect ISO 5 areas, Compounding Room, Chemo Room and ante room. 2. The firm does not use a sporicidal agent to disinfect the clean room including the ISO 5 area. Daily cleaning of the ISO 5 critical areas consists of Sterile 70% isopropyl alcohol. 3. On 1211/14, a spray bottle labeled "water" was observed on a tray in the ISO 6 Compounding Room. The firm reported that the spray bottle contains Sterile Water For Irrigation used to clean up crystallized drug residue resulting from spills in the ISO 5 area that cannot be removed using sterile 70% isopropyl alcohol. The spray bottle is non-sterile but sanitized externally using sterile 70% isopropyl alcohol prior to entry into the ISO 6 Compounding Room.
detail_text_ko: 구체적으로, 1. 귀사는 ISO 5 구역, 조제실, 항암제실(Chemo Room), 전실을 청소하고 소독하는 데 사용하는 비멸균 Accel TB (0.5% hydrogen peroxide), 먹는 물과 1:10 으로 희석한 표백제 용액, 멸균 70% isopropyl alcohol 의 적합성과 효과를 보장하기 위한 세척 효능 연구를 수행하지 않았다. 2. 귀사는 ISO 5 구역을 포함한 청정실을 소독하는 데 포자 사멸제를 사용하지 않는다. ISO 5 핵심 구역의 일일 청소는 멸균 70% isopropyl alcohol 로 이루어진다. 3. 1211/14 에 ISO 6 조제실의 트레이 위에서 "water" 라는 라벨이 붙은 분무병이 관찰되었다. 귀사는 이 분무병에 ISO 5 구역에서 유출로 생긴 결정화된 약물 잔여물을 멸균 70% isopropyl alcohol 로 제거할 수 없을 때 청소하는 데 쓰는 Sterile Water For Irrigation 이 들어 있다고 보고했다. 이 분무병은 비멸균이지만 ISO 6 조제실에 반입하기 전에 멸균 70% isopropyl alcohol 로 외부를 소독한다.
